title: Backend Real DB Persistence, Seeding & CORS/Headers
acceptance_criteria: CORS configured in Program.cs allowing Vite frontend origin (http://localhost:5173, http://localhost:80, http://localhost:3000) and any local development origin.
CORS explicitly exposes headers 'ETag', 'Retry-After', 'X-Correlation-Id', and 'Location' via WithExposedHeaders.

DatabaseSeeder seeds initial active InventoryItems for MainHouseholdId (at least 5 items with varying FEFO dates: expired, critical <24h, expiring soon, fresh) and base ShoppingList items so database starts populated.
EnsureCreated / migration strategy initializes PostgreSQL schema robustly on startup without silently swallowing critical DB connection errors.
RFC 9457 ProblemDetails middleware returns strict application/problem+json content-type with required fields: type, title, status, detail, instance, errorCode, traceId.
